claims.allowed: Fixed eight-reflection TTA improved Scan Dice point estimates on all six reported cohorts (internal270, Africa95, CPTAC33, WAW preop152, WAW early-postop31, UCSD-BraTS2024test56); paired Scan intervals were entirely above zero on internal270, CPTAC33 and WAW preop152, and crossed zero on Africa95, WAW-post31 and UCSD-BraTS2024test56; Point deltas were never negative; saved-count posthoc decomposition shows a positive precision delta in 5/5 external cohorts with counts.
claims.forbidden: Flip8 is universally significant, free, or a one-forward single-model improvement. Do not call the six-cohort direction a pooled or universally significant effect; deployment stays 8x.

claims.allowed: The archived GCSAM184 checkpoint had a large paired Dice advantage on Africa95; across five external cohorts its predicted volume and recall point estimates were always higher than Full, while precision was mixed and Point never higher. The fixed184 recipe failed internal replication.
claims.forbidden: GCSAM optimization causally or reproducibly improves cross-domain segmentation, or wider coverage means universally better accuracy/Point.

claims.allowed: GCSAM184's paired Scan advantage over Full972 KD168 is entirely positive only on Africa95 (+0.068617). On UCSD-BraTS2024test56 (patient-disjoint, post-treatment, near-training-domain) the same comparison is entirely negative (-0.012312, CI [-0.025822,-0.000092], Point -4); the other five revealed cohorts cross zero. The direction is cohort-reversible.
claims.forbidden: Never write that GCSAM is 'generally higher externally'. Never use any revealed cohort to select rho, epoch, checkpoint, threshold, views or routers.

claims.allowed: Official UCSD float32 and mirror uint8 images differed in all 75 cases, but same-model paired Dice source intervals crossed zero and point changes were 0 or -1.
claims.forbidden: The mirror is official TCIA data, or float32 correction is a new independent external confirmation.

claims.allowed: On WAW152, GCSAM identity and Full Flip8 had nearly tied Dice point estimates (0.693601 vs 0.693494); GCSAM versus Full identity was positive but uncertain, while Flip8 versus identity had a positive paired interval and two more point hits.
claims.forbidden: WAW proves GCSAM superiority, hidden-test performance, or a universal Flip8 effect.

claims.allowed: No-N4 helped fold E but failed fold F gates; Otsu-N4 was small positive on E and negative on F. These implementations did not provide stable promotion evidence.
claims.forbidden: N4 is always necessary, no-N4 can never work, or Otsu masking is generally impossible.

claims.allowed: Name the cohort, metric, and forward budget: internal overall Full Flip8; internal 1x Scan GCSAM; internal 1x Subject/Point Full identity; external winners differ by cohort and metric.
claims.forbidden: AFlow/GCSAM/Full/Flip8 is simply the best model without a cohort and overall-versus-single scope.

claims.allowed: Africa95, CPTAC33, WAW preop152, and patient-disjoint-from-preop WAW postop31 are public external-to-project cohorts with stated separation limits; UCSD official-float is a same-cohort source correction.
claims.forbidden: Any current external result is pristine blind, server hidden, or patient-ID-proven disjoint.

claims.allowed: MOTUM-HGG29 source and shared orientation passed, but one case had 892 WT voxels outside the image support crop, so performance was never accessed.
claims.forbidden: MOTUM has a model score, or case0001 can be dropped/padded using GT after the failure.

claims.allowed: In WAW152, all five cases with zero Dice for all three outputs were grade2 and four were pure FLAIR-label2. Pure label2 scans were 17.11% of WAW versus 3.09% of train972, supporting an observability and coverage limitation without proving causality.
claims.forbidden: Use ground-truth label composition or grade to exclude cases, route models, tune thresholds, or claim that every nonenhancing tumor is impossible.

claims.allowed: On WAW early-postop31, 13 of16 Full point misses and14 of17 GCSAM misses landed in GT resection cavity. Train972 already contains label4 in83.74% of scans, but binary WT collapses RC with ordinary background; this supports a representation gap without proving an RC head.
claims.forbidden: Claim the diagnostic Point caused the direct mask Dice, use GT resection cavity at deployment, add RC avoidance from this revealed cohort, or generalize day0-22 behavior to all post-treatment scans.

claims.allowed: OpenNeuro ds007045 v1.0.1 provides a frozen 334-case processing-T1ce/final-mask intersection with expert-reviewed/refined BraTS labels; 332 passed the canonical input gate, but BO118 and KA86 had 4 and 6 WT voxels outside the positive-image crop, so the panel closed before external model or performance access.
claims.forbidden: Report a 332-case score, exclude the two failures, use GT-selected padding/cropping, imply the checkpoint failed on this cohort, or claim all future full-FOV approaches are impossible.

claims.allowed: UCSD-BraTS2024test56 (56 scans/41 subjects) is the public 2026-01-22 release of the UCSD share of the BraTS-GLI 2024 hidden test set; patients are disjoint from the 1,350-case training union and the previously accessed UCSD main release via the official v3 clinical mapping. Full972 KD168 reached Point 56/56 (identity and Flip8), the highest Point of any external cohort; Scan/Subject about 0.730-0.734.
claims.forbidden: Do not call it hidden blind, institution-disjoint or cross-institution generalization evidence (UCSD is a BraTS2024 source site and the same institution as UCSD75). Do not mix its rows with UCSD75, internal test270 or other external sections. Do not re-run or tune on it.

global_rules.confidence_intervals: Do not turn a point-estimate lead into significance when the paired interval crosses zero.
global_rules.cohorts: Do not pool or rank absolute Dice across cohorts with different stages, labels, acquisition, preprocessing, or evidence roles.
global_rules.access: Do not use revealed internal/external results to select checkpoint, threshold, view, fusion, preprocessing, postprocessing, or cases.
global_rules.training_source: All inherited checkpoints retain unresolved local Kaggle mirror to official Synapse corrected-v2 parity.
